info.title: Eclipse Project Management Infrastructure (PMI) RESTful API
info.description:
This describes the resources that make up the Eclipse Project Management Infrastructure (PMI) REST API.
You can contribute to this document via our [git repository](https://gitlab.eclipse.org/eclipsefdn/it/websites/projects.eclipse.org).
If you have any problems or requests please submit an [issue](https://gitlab.eclipse.org/eclipsefdn/it/websites/projects.eclipse.org/-/issues).

### Rate Limit
This API currently limits users to 1000 authenticated requests and 1000 anonymous requests an hour.
### Pagination
Information about pagination is provided in the Link header of an API call. For example, let's make a curl request to the eclipse_profile API, to find out how many org_eclipse_oomph records exist for the user:
```
curl -I \"https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects?page=1&pagesize=20\"
```
The -I parameter indicates that we only care about the headers, not the content. In examining the result, you'll notice some information in the Link header that looks like this:
```
<https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects?page=2&pagesize=2>; rel="next",
<https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects?page=27&pagesize=2>; rel="last",
<https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects?page=1&pagesize=2>; rel="first",
<https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects?page=1&pagesize=2>; rel="self"
```
Let's break that down. rel=\"next\" says that the next page is page=2. This makes sense, since by default, all paginated queries start at page 1. rel=\"last\" provides some more information, stating that the last page of results is on page 27.
Keep in mind that you should always rely on these link relations provided to you. Don't try to guess or construct your own URL.

### Error States
The common [HTTP Response Status Codes](https://github.com/for-GET/know-your-http-well/blob/master/status-codes.md) are used.

get.description:
### Overview

Retrieve metadata for all projects.

parameters.name: github_only
parameters.description: Select only the projects that have GitHub repositories or a GitHub organisation defined.

parameters.name: gitlab_only
parameters.description: Select only the projects that have GitLab repositories defined.

parameters.name: spec_project
parameters.description: Filter to specification projects only. Set to any non-zero integer to enable the filter.

parameters.name: spec_project_working_group
parameters.description: Filter projects by their specification project working group ID (e.g. `jakarta-ee`).

parameters.name: working_group
parameters.description: Filter projects by their associated working group ID.

parameters.name: industry_collaboration
parameters.description: Filter projects by their associated industry collaboration (working group) ID.

parameters.name: technology_types
parameters.description: Filter projects by technology type name.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter projects by state. Accepted values: `Regular`, `Archived`, `Incubating` (case-insensitive). Multiple values may be passed as a comma-separated list, e.g. `state=Regular,Incubating`. Values outside the allowed set are silently ignored.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The index of the page to retrieve, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: The number of records to get per page, defaults to 20. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The order in which results are returned. Defaults to `ASC`. Accepted values: `ASC`, `DESC`, `RANDOM`. When `RANDOM` is used the response is cached for 5 hours.

200.description: Array of projects matching the query.

example.name: Jakarta Batch
example.summary: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification.
example.scope: Project Scope: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification and related artifacts.

get.description:
### Overview

Retrieve information for a specific project.

**Note** that underscores in a project ID are treated as dots (e.g. `technology_dash` resolves to `technology.dash`). A `.json` suffix is also accepted and stripped.

### Examples:

* https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects/technology_dash
* https://projects.eclipse.org/api/projects/ecd_che

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of the project. Underscores are treated as dots (e.g. `technology_dash` → `technology.dash`). A `.json` suffix is accepted and stripped.

200.description: An array containing the matching project (with full HTML description).

X-Rate-Limit-Limit.description: The rate limit ceiling for the requester.

X-Rate-Limit-Remaining.description: The number of requests left in the current rate-limit window.

X-Rate-Limit-Reset.description: The number of seconds left until the rate-limit window resets.

example.name: Jakarta Batch
example.summary: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification.
example.description: Project Scope: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification and related artifacts.
example.scope: Project Scope: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification and related artifacts.

get.description:
### Overview

Retrieve a paginated list of releases associated with the given project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of the project. Underscores are treated as dots.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The index of the page to retrieve, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: The number of records to get per page, defaults to 20. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The order in which results are returned. Defaults to `ASC`. Accepted values: `ASC`, `DESC`.

200.description: A wrapper object containing the paginated releases.

get.description:
### Overview

Retrieve a paginated list of reviews associated with the given project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of the project. Underscores are treated as dots.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The index of the page to retrieve, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: The number of records to get per page, defaults to 20. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The order in which results are returned. Defaults to `ASC`. Accepted values: `ASC`, `DESC`.

200.description: A wrapper object containing the paginated reviews.

reviews.summary: The committer team proposes releasing Jakarta Batch 3.0.

get.description:
### Overview

Retrieve a paginated list of Eclipse project proposals.

Unlike the projects index, pagination metadata is included in the response body alongside the `result` array, in addition to the `Link` header.

parameters.name: spec_project
parameters.description: Filter to specification projects only. Set to any non-zero integer to enable.

parameters.name: spec_project_working_group
parameters.description: Filter by specification project working group ID.

parameters.name: industry_collaboration
parameters.description: Filter by industry collaboration (working group) ID.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by proposal state (case-insensitive). Accepts a single value (`state=Active`) or an array (`state[]=Active&state[]=Draft`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The index of the page to retrieve, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: The number of records to get per page, defaults to 20. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The order in which results are returned. Defaults to `ASC`. Accepted values: `ASC`, `DESC`, `RANDOM`.

200.description: A paginated wrapper object containing the proposals and pagination metadata.

result.name: New Eclipse Project Proposal
result.summary: A short plain-text summary of the proposal.

get.description:
### Overview

parameters.name: nid
parameters.description: The Drupal node ID of the proposal.

200.description: An array containing the matching proposal.

example.name: New Eclipse Project Proposal
example.summary: A short plain-text summary of the proposal.

Retrieve a paginated list of Eclipse Interest Groups.

parameters.name: project_id

parameters.name: page

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: The number of records to get per page, defaults to 20. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: order_by

get.summary: Fetch GitHub Repositories for all Projects
get.description:
### Overview

Returns a map of Eclipse project IDs to their associated GitHub repositories. Optionally filter by a specific repository name substring.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Filter by repository path (org/repo, e.g. `eclipse-ee4j/batch-api`). A `LIKE '%<value>'` pattern is applied, so a partial trailing match is sufficient.

200.description: A map of project IDs to their GitHub repository data.

get.summary: Fetch GitHub Repositories for a Project
get.description:
### Overview

Returns the GitHub repositories for a specific Eclipse project. Underscores in `project_id` are treated as dots.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of the project. Underscores are treated as dots.

200.description: A map containing the GitHub repositories for the given project (empty map if not found).

get.description:
### Overview

Returns a map of all simultaneous releases (Eclipse release trains), keyed by the release URL slug (e.g. `2023-12`).

200.description: A map of simultaneous release slugs to their release data.

get.description:
### Overview

Returns a specific simultaneous release (Eclipse release train) by its URL slug.

parameters.name: simrel
parameters.description: The URL slug of the simultaneous release (e.g. `2023-12`).

200.description: A map containing the requested simultaneous release.

Committer.title: Committer
Committer.description: A person with a role on an Eclipse project (committer, contributor, or project lead).

username.description: Eclipse account username (may be null for proposals where the person has no account yet).

url.description: Absolute URL to the person's profile on api.eclipse.org.

org.description: GitHub organisation name for the project (may be empty).

ignored_repos.description: GitHub repository names excluded from project tooling.

project_group.description: GitLab project group namespace (may be empty).

ignored_sub_groups.description: GitLab sub-group names excluded from project tooling.

name.description: Mailing list name (also the local part of the email address).

url.description: URL to the mailing list archive on accounts.eclipse.org.

build_level.description: SLSA build level achieved by the project (empty string if not set).

SecurityTeamGroups.title: SecurityTeamGroups
SecurityTeamGroups.description: Flags indicating which standard project roles are automatically included in the security team.

individual_members.description: Individually named security team members who are not already covered by the group roles.

Pagination.title: Pagination
Pagination.description: Pagination metadata included in some list responses.

pagesize.description: Maximum number of results per page.

result_start.description: One-based index of the first result on this page.

result_end.description: One-based index of the last result on this page. -1 when the page is empty.

result_size.description: Number of results on this page.

total_result_size.description: Total number of results across all pages.

FetchProjectsresponse.title: FetchProjectsresponse
FetchProjectsresponse.description: Project data returned by the projects list endpoint (without the full HTML description field).

short_project_id.description: Last segment of the project ID (e.g. `batch`).

summary.description: Short plain-text summary of the project.

url.description: URL of the project page on projects.eclipse.org.

website_url.description: Project's external website URL (falls back to the PMI URL when not set).

website_repo.description: Repository URL for the project's website source code.

logo.description: URL of the project logo image, or empty string.

tags.description: Taxonomy tag labels assigned to the project.

gitlab_repos.description: GitLab repository entries. Currently always an empty array; reserved for future use.

gerrit_repos.description: Gerrit repository entries. Currently always an empty array; reserved for future use.

working_groups.description: Industry collaborations / working groups the project participates in.

industry_collaborations.description: Alias for `working_groups`; always contains the same data.

spec_project_working_group.description: The specification working group this project produces a specification for. Returns an empty object `{}` when the project is not a specification project, or an object with `name` and `id` when it is. TODO: the PHP implementation overwrites the value in a loop and returns the last matched term only; consumers should handle both empty-object and WorkingGroup-shaped values.

provisioned.description: Whether the project's infrastructure has been provisioned (project is active).

latest_release_name.description: Title of the most recent release, or empty string if none exist.

releases.description: Absolute URL to this project's releases API endpoint.

top_level_project.description: Project ID of the top-level project, or empty string for top-level projects.

dev_list.description: Primary development mailing list. Returns an empty array `[]` when no dev list is configured, or a DevList object when one is set.

mailing_lists.description: Additional mailing lists for the project.

reviews.description: Absolute URL to this project's reviews API endpoint.

gettingstarted_url.description: URL to the project's getting-started guide.

download_url.description: URL to the project's download page.

example.name: Jakarta Batch
example.summary: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification.
example.scope: Project Scope: The Jakarta Batch project defines and maintains the Jakarta Batch specification and related artifacts.

RetrieveaProjectresponse.title: RetrieveaProjectresponse
RetrieveaProjectresponse.description: Full project data returned by the single-project endpoint. Identical to FetchProjectsresponse but also includes the `description` field containing the full HTML-rendered project description.

tracked.description: Whether download statistics are tracked for this release.

associated_files.description: Values from `field_release_download_files` associated with this release.

url.description: Absolute URL of the release page on projects.eclipse.org.

date.description: Release date formatted as `Y-m-d`, or empty string if not set.

releases.description: Paginated list of releases for the project.

id.description: Drupal node ID of the review.

slides_url.description: Absolute URL of the review page on projects.eclipse.org.

review_name.description: Human-readable review name with the trailing ` Review` suffix stripped.

status.description: Review outcome. Known values: `fail`, `success`, `withdrawn`, `ongoing`. Any unrecognised stored value is normalised to `unknown_state`.

summary.description: Body summary field value, or the full body text if no summary is available.

example.summary: The committer team proposes releasing Jakarta Batch 3.0.

reviews.description: Paginated list of reviews for the project.

reviews.summary: The committer team proposes releasing Jakarta Batch 3.0.

id.description: Drupal node ID of the proposal.

parent.description: Project ID of the parent project, or empty string.

top_level_project.description: Project ID of the top-level project, or empty string.

industry_collaborations.description: Working groups / industry collaborations associated with this proposal.

summary.description: Plain-text summary truncated to 200 characters (HTML stripped).

url.description: Absolute URL to the proposal page.

project_url.description: Absolute URL to the resulting project page if the project already exists, otherwise empty string.

spec_project.description: Specification working group(s) associated with this proposal (at most one entry).

committers.description: Initial committers listed in the proposal. The `username` field may be null when a committer does not yet have an Eclipse account.

patent_license.description: Patent license selected for this proposal.

licenses.description: License term labels selected for this proposal.

example.name: New Eclipse Project Proposal
example.summary: A short plain-text summary of the proposal.

ProposalsIndexResponse.title: ProposalsIndexResponse
ProposalsIndexResponse.description: Paginated proposals list. Unlike the projects index, this endpoint preserves the pagination metadata in the response body alongside the `result` array.

TextContent.title: TextContent
TextContent.description: A long-text field with a plain-text summary and an HTML-rendered full version.

website.description: URL to the interest group's website, or empty string.

members.description: URL to the interest group's members page, or empty string.

InterestGroupGitlabInfo.title: InterestGroupGitlabInfo
InterestGroupGitlabInfo.description: GitLab group information derived from the interest group's Foundation DB project ID.

ignored_sub_groups.description: Currently always empty for interest groups.

InterestGroupUser.title: InterestGroupUser
InterestGroupUser.description: A user associated with an interest group.

url.description: Absolute URL to the person's profile on api.eclipse.org.

organization.description: TODO - structure depends on FoundationDB organisation data; treat as opaque object.

logo.description: Absolute URL to the interest group logo image, or empty string.

project_id.description: Foundation DB project ID for this interest group (e.g. `foundation-internal.ig.some-group`).

short_project_id.description: Last segment of the project ID with the `foundation-internal.ig.` prefix removed.

mailing_list.description: Mailing list e-mail address from `field_ig_mailing_list`, or empty string.

GithubProjectEntry.title: GithubProjectEntry
GithubProjectEntry.description: GitHub repository data for a single Eclipse project.

repos.description: GitHub repository paths in `org/repo` format (the `https://github.com/` prefix is stripped).

specification_project.description: Whether this project has a specification working group configured.

GithubIndexResponse.title: GithubIndexResponse
GithubIndexResponse.description: A map of Eclipse project IDs to their GitHub repository data. Keys are project IDs (e.g. `ee4j.batch`).

SimultaneousReleaseProject.title: SimultaneousReleaseProject
SimultaneousReleaseProject.description: A project's contribution to a simultaneous release.

new_and_noteworthy_url.description: URL to the project's New and Noteworthy page for this release. May be null or empty if not configured.

SimultaneousReleaseEntry.title: SimultaneousReleaseEntry
SimultaneousReleaseEntry.description: Data for a single simultaneous release (Eclipse release train).

release_date.description: Unix timestamp of the release date.

previous_release.description: Link to the preceding simultaneous release. TODO: the `previous_name` SQL alias in the implementation has a trailing comma which may cause the `release_name` value to be empty in practice — verify against live data.

release_name.description: URL slug of the previous simultaneous release.

release_url.description: Absolute URL to the previous release's API endpoint.

projects.description: Map of Eclipse project IDs to their release data within this simultaneous release.

SimultaneousReleasesMap.title: SimultaneousReleasesMap
SimultaneousReleasesMap.description: A map of simultaneous release URL slugs (e.g. `2023-12`) to their release data.
